text:
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy started for service=llm-route v=2.4.1 -> initiating canary cohorts and FF toggle plan
release-manager: quick heads-up — toggling feature flag `llmroute_v2` to canary cohorts. plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 10m holdpoints. change window ends 02:00 UTC.
alex: copying release notes here: https://redwood-internal/release/llm-route/2.4.1 — contains perf fixes and model pinning behavior. please verify notes before we hit 20%.
tara: ack. monitoring dashboards up: latency, tail-p99, token-cost. alert thresholds same as last rollout: p99 > 1200ms or error-rate > 1% -> immediate rollback.
rohit: internal note: we've pinned model checksum to m-ops/llama-13b@sha256:abc123 so /older-route won't be auto-upgraded. doing that to avoid drift.
alex: confirm the automation will pin routing to v2.4.1 for cohorts until 100% completion?
deploy-bot: yes — cohort routing pinned. will auto-unpin only on explicit cherrypick or rollback reversal.
infra-oncall: adding a tiny safety: if cost-per-token delta > 30% for 2 consecutive holds, pause ramp and ping #eng-oncall.
release-manager: update: starting ramp to 1% now. tagging release notes in the deployment message.
tara: 1% in prod (canary-1). telemetry looks green so far. no errors.
rohit: watching model-serving cache fill — KV-hit-rate steady.
alex: move to 5% in 8m if holds clear, otherwise hold and triage.
release-manager: scheduled holdpoint at +10m. next step will require explicit ack from @tara or @infra-oncall.
deploy-bot: ramp -> 5% initiated. cohort ids: c-1 -> c-2.
tara: 5% looks ok, p99 ~ 230ms, error-rate 0.12%. thumbs up :thumbsup:
rohit: small spike in token-cost (+8%) during 5% but within expected.
alex: good. i noticed a small message formatting regression in structured output tests — file an issue if it trips at 20%.
release-manager: flagged a test-run in CI failing ~1 in 1000 for structured JSON. not blocking but watch.
infra-oncall: if structured output failures correlate with dev-ex regression, we'll hold at 20% and roll back.
rohit: ready to pin fallback model variant (q8) if we see latency regressions during 20% so we can gracefully degrade cost.
deploy-bot: starting ramp -> 20%. automated watchers enabled (telemetry, e2e-sanity, cost-delta).
tara: taking 10m watch now. setting manual ack timer.
alex: FYI — if we need to rollback, prefer soft rollback by flipping `llmroute_v2` back to v1 route and keep v2 images for postmortem. That keeps traffic stable.
release-manager: noted. if we rollback, we will also post a brief rollback note in release channel and attach traces.
rohit: 20% steady. one structured-output failure observed but not correlated with downstream errors.
infra-oncall: p99 still ~240ms, error-rate 0.18%. no alerts.
tara: i'm hesitant to go to 100% until we clear structured-output sample run. can we hold and run a targeted eval set?
alex: +1. run evals on the failing prompt set and check for diff in tokenization.
rohit: kicking off eval job now: job-id ejob-20240315-88. will post results here.
deploy-bot: holdpoint reached at 20% at ts=1759876590. wait-for-ack required from {tara, infra-oncall} to proceed. auto-rollback on timeout (30m).
tara: ack to continue? i want the eval results first. holding until ejob completes.
infra-oncall: ack hold. i'm oncall and will keep watch; no proceed.
alex: understood — pause ramp. change window still fine. we can continue after eval.
rohit: eval done. summary: 500 samples run; 3 failures of JSON-structure (0.6%). diff attached: small trailing whitespace issues in model output. looks like a tokenizer edge-case.
tara: 0.6% is under the threshold we considered risky but those failures hit a critical customer prompt in our soak list. i'd prefer a targeted rollback to 5% for now and a hotfix rather than full 100%.
alex: proposal: step back to 5% (soft egress via FF set) and open a hotfix branch to address tokenizer trim. we keep v2 pinned for investigation.
release-manager: approved. issuing FF toggle: rollback to 5% now and mark rollout paused. will update release notes: "paused at 20% due to structured-output regressions; rolled back to 5% while we hotfix."
deploy-bot: toggled `llmroute_v2`: 20% -> 5%. cohort traffic rebalanced.
infra-oncall: monitoring. p99 and errors stable post-stepdown.
rohit: starting hotfix branch: fix/tokenizer-trim, will run unit + targeted e2e. estimated ~90m.
tara: thanks. please include the failing prompt ids in the PR description.
alex: also add a small canary job for the hotfix: 1% then 5% back to 20%.
release-manager: adding a follow-up doc in the release ticket with timeline and rollback rationale. also sending a short note to #customer-success for visibility.
rohit: PR opened: https://redwood-internal/pulls/4821 — includes test coverage and repro harness.
tara: running the targeted eval on PR now.
rohit: PR eval results look clean: 0/500 structured-output failures on branch.
release-manager: once tara confirms, we'll stage a fast toggle back: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with shorter holds (5m) and increased observability sampling.
tara: confirmed. ok to proceed with cautious ramp when infra-oncall gives final ack.
infra-oncall: ack. proceeding to ramp to 20% now. will watch closely.
deploy-bot: ramp -> 20% initiated per manual ack.
alex: thanks everyone. i'll draft a quick postmortem blurb: root cause tokenizer trim, mitigation hotfix, follow-up tests added.
release-manager: closing note: leaving v2 pinned for another 24h to monitor, will unpin after stable 100% run and no regressions in next 6h.
rohit: monitoring, will post any anomalies.
ara: (bot) reminder scheduled: post-rollout health check in 4h."
